verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for an app tied to a user's GitHub account, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no export or account-data-portability feature in GitHub Mobile. The REST and GraphQL APIs that can 'retrieve data' are developer building blocks on the host platform, not a product export capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
